ranked.rationale: Direct compile dependency actively used for logging in DiscountCalculator (internal invoicing service); CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) CVSS 10.0 with remote-code-execution impact and public exploitation; 8 total CVEs; fix available in 2.26.0.

Direct compile dependency; carries 54 known deserialization/gadget-chain CVEs (CVE-2019-14379 CVSS 9.8, plus dozens more CRITICAL/HIGH); serialization library increases exposure; fix available in 2.22.0 (major upgrade).
Direct compile dependency paired with log4j-core; recently NVD-scored CVEs (CVE-2026-34479, CVSS 7.5); same remediation path as log4j-core (2.26.0).

Direct compile dependency for database connectivity in an invoice-processing service handling financial records; CVE-2023-22102 CVSS 8.3; also carries a GPL-2.0 license-policy violation; patch fix available in 8.0.33.
Transitive dependency of mysql-connector-java; CVE-2024-7254 CVSS 7.5 (unbounded recursion / DoS in parsing); serialization library; fix available in 3.21.7.
Direct compile dependency; CVE-2023-2976 CVSS 7.1 (insecure temp-directory creation) plus CVE-2020-8908; widely used core utility library increasing blast radius; fix available in 32.0.1-jre.
Transitive of jackson-databind; CVE-2018-1000873 CVSS 6.5; low standalone exposure but compounds jackson-databind risk; fix in 2.9.10.
Direct compile dependency; CVE-2021-29425 CVSS 4.8 (path-traversal in file utilities) plus CVE-2024-47554 (DoS); years behind current release; fix available in 2.14.0.
Direct compile dependency; CVE-2025-48924 CVSS 5.3 (uncontrolled recursion / DoS); years out of date; fix available in 3.18.0.
Transitive of jackson-databind with no CVEs of its own; low risk but should be upgraded alongside jackson-databind for consistency.
